parent: Phase-26 confirmed the 62-feature interaction identifier on fresh Burgers seeds; Phase-14 previously established unified transfer with the smaller identifier on wave, Gray-Scott, NLS, and advection
question: Can the same 62-feature token-space interaction identifier serve as one unified context-only model across wave, Gray-Scott, NLS, advection, and Burgers without regressing any previously solved family?

primary_identifier.construction: constant + 18 full fixed real 3x3 Fourier spatial coordinates + seven center degree-2/3 monomials + every product between center u or v and each of the 18 spatial coordinates
primary_identifier.recursive_projection: same frozen Phase-10 18-bit companded token projection after every predicted step

secondary_control.construction: linear full-Fourier spatial plus center polynomial library used as the Phase-25 control
secondary_control.purpose: paired diagnostic only; cannot rescue or redefine the primary gate

primary_rule: PASS only if the unchanged 62-feature token model has rollout MSE / raw-state persistence MSE < 1.0 on every one of the 19 splits in every one of the 3 fresh registered replicates: 57/57 cells. Any single ratio >= 1.0 is Phase-27 FAIL. No retries or replacement seeds.
failure_policy: All registered outcomes are retained. No family-specific feature pruning, ridge change, context change, routing, posthoc stabilization, or seed replacement.
collision_policy: If any 827270xxx registered seed is discovered to collide with a previously consumed registered seed before execution, stop before consuming it and preregister a repair namespace only for unconsumed seeds.
claim_limit: Known synthetic dynamics under the fixed local 3x3 support and benchmark distributions only. A pass establishes unified benchmark compatibility of this fixed hypothesis class; it is not new-physics discovery or unrestricted scientific-law discovery.
